answer: Each task is instantiated from a future drand quicknet pulse, with its round number and task identifier bound into the challenge hash; threshold BLS signatures make the pulse publicly verifiable and unpredictable before release. A whisper, gale, or cedar task therefore cannot be precomputed offline, while registration costs and rate limits—not randomness alone—make mass Sybil farming expensive. Commit-reveal submissions are checked against the same derived challenge.
